thread:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — customer hit ambiguous 502s when hosted falls back to their Private deployment. Responses lack any 'fallback-reason' metadata and control-plane logs don't show the chain. Anyone else seen this?
Sam Patel: Seen it. Hosted proxy sets x-rw-fallback but our older private sidecar strips unknown headers. So hosted -> private path loses reason and we get opaque 502.
Li Wei: Can you paste a minimal repro? suspect the proxy rewrite rules.
Maria Chen: Repro (redacted):
```
curl -i -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-neox","input":"test"}'
```
Response we see:
```
HTTP/2 502
content-type: text/plain
content-length: 14

upstream error
```
No x-rw-fallback header.
Jess Martin: The adapter intentionally scrubs unknown headers for security; we didn't want internal metadata exposed to customer networks. But we can namespace and mark them as internal.
Ben O'Neill: We need a stable, documented error contract if we do this. Customers write retry logic based on codes; a custom header would need clear semantics and allowed values.
Ankur Rao: Proposal: normalize the fallthrough signature across hosting modes. Small machine-readable token either via header or a tiny JSON body. Fields: code, retryable, origin. Example in trace: origin=hosted|dedicated|private.
Sam Patel: Prefer header to avoid breaking clients that expect text/plain. Something like `x-rw-error: code=MODEL_UNAVAILABLE;retry=1;origin=private` — single-line parsable token.
Maria Chen: Agree on header. Also need canonical list of codes: MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, CAPACITY_DEGRADED, AUTH_FAIL, KVCACHE_MISS, ROUTE_TIMEOUT. Map each to recommended retry behavior and SLO impact tag.
Jess Martin: Addendum: ensure the proxy can opt-in to forward the header only to control-plane endpoints (internal) and redact for customer-facing responses. That keeps security posture.
Li Wei: Telemetry note: we must also stamp traces with a routing_hint so billing/latency attribution doesn't lose the actual origin. I can add a tracer tag `rw.origin=private`.
deploy-bot: deploy status: staging proxy change pushed at 1779001250 — added x-rw-error passthrough in staging.
ops-bot: alert: watch for elevated 502 rates when passthrough enabled — SLO dashboard updated.
Ben O'Neill: Danger: some customers will see extra headers and could rely on them. We must version this. Suggest `x-rw-error-v=1` or include `x-rw-error-v: 1` in responses.
Ankur Rao: Actionable RFC items draft: 1) header name and versioning scheme, 2) canonical error code set + retry semantics, 3) proxy opt-in policy + redact rules, 4) trace telemetry tags, 5) tests and migration plan.
Maria Chen: I'll open RFC PR with the schema and proposed code set. Will include unit tests for adapter translation and e2e with private sidecar.
Sam Patel: Once PR lands, I'll add a feature flag to the hosted proxy for gradual rollout.
Jess Martin: Also schedule a short sync with Security to sign off on the redact rules.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Filing follow-ups now — will post PR link here.
Sam Patel: +1 :thumbsup:
